title: Security Deposit Transfer When a Customer Moves
content:
A held Security Deposit whose kind allows transfer on a move moves to the customer's new service agreement when the customer stops service at one address and starts at another.

## Conditions

1. The deposit moves only to a service agreement of the same customer in pending start or active status, as the agreement record shows it.
2. The fully secured date, the refund review date and the interest periods continue unchanged after the move.

## Status of the receiving agreement

| Status of the customer's new service agreement | May the deposit move to it? |
|---|---|
| Pending start | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Notice pending | No |
| Disconnected | No |
| Closed | No |

An agreement of another customer never receives the deposit.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Residential New Service Deposit became fully secured on 1 February and carries a refund review date of 1 February of the following year. The customer stops service at the old address and starts service at a new address whose agreement is pending start. The deposit moves to the new agreement; its fully secured date stays 1 February, its refund review date stays 1 February of the following year, and its interest periods run on unchanged.
